grid.name: grid
grid.title: Grid & Layout System
grid.description: Centered container, 12-column row/col grid, responsive auto-fit CSS grid, Bento grid, and holy-grail page shells.

navbar.name: navbar
navbar.title: Header & Navigation Bar
navbar.description: Brand header with navigation links, search trigger, action buttons, glassmorphism, and responsive wrapping.

button.name: button
button.title: Button & Button Group
button.description: Interactive button system with spinner loading state, icon buttons, Sakura Pink focus rings, and joined button groups.

input.name: input
input.title: Form Inputs & Floating Labels
input.description: Form inputs, textarea, select dropdowns, input groups with addons/icons, and :user-valid / :user-invalid state validation.

form-controls.name: form-controls
form-controls.title: Switch, Checkbox & Radio
form-controls.description: Custom accessible toggle switches, checkboxes with indeterminate state, radio buttons, and interactive choice cards.

badge.name: badge
badge.title: Badge & Status Indicator
badge.description: Pill tags, status indicators, live pulsing dots, removable badges, and semantic color accents.

modal.name: modal
modal.title: Modal & Dialog
modal.description: Accessible HTML5 <dialog> modal with @starting-style animations, light-dismiss backdrop, escape key handler, and clean layout.

toast.name: toast
toast.title: Toast Notification
toast.description: Floating notification alerts with auto-dismiss countdown bar, corner positioning, and event-driven JavaScript engine.

card.name: card
card.title: Card Component
card.description: Flexible content containers with header, body, footer, glassmorphism, neo-brutalist border, and gradient rims.

tabs.name: tabs
tabs.title: Tabs Navigation
tabs.description: Accessible tabs with arrow-key keyboard navigation, find-in-page hidden="until-found" integration, and modern active states.

accordion.name: accordion
accordion.title: Accordion & Collapse
accordion.description: Native <details name="..."> accordions with zero mandatory JavaScript, animated chevron indicators, and card styling.

table.name: table
table.title: Responsive Data Table
table.description: Sticky-header data table with column click sorting and container query (@container) mobile card transformation.

pagination.name: pagination
pagination.title: Pagination Bar
pagination.description: Page switcher controls with active states, previous/next handlers, and joined or rounded pill shapes.

progress.name: progress
progress.title: Progress Bar
progress.description: Linear progress bars with striped animations, indeterminate loading states, and glowing Sakura Pink styling.

skeleton.name: skeleton
skeleton.title: Skeleton Loader
skeleton.description: Shimmer and pulse skeleton placeholders preserving page layout while content loads.

avatar.name: avatar
avatar.title: Avatar & Avatar Group
avatar.description: User avatars with online/busy/away status indicators, fallback initials, and overlapping avatar stack groups.
